expectedResult: Unsupported file type is blocked with a safe message and no metadata/object is created.
actualResult: The HTML/Browser file chooser accept filter refused the CSV before the SAP upload handler received it. No metadata was created, but the application-level safe message could not be exercised in this Browser surface.
reviewBoundary: Use a native/manual chooser or controlled direct request that can bypass the client accept filter while remaining safe.

evidence.description: Evidence section remained empty after the Browser chooser filtered the unsupported file.

privacyReview.notes: Synthetic 34-byte CSV only; no content was transmitted to the app handler.

limitations: Client accept filter prevents application-level unsupported-type validation in this automation surface.
